test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: You remiend me of somone I knew once
You reminde me of someone I knew once.
You remind me of someone I knew onse.
You remind me of someone I knew once

solution:
The correct sentence is: **"You remind me of someone I knew once.**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The correct spelling is "**remind**," not "remiend" or "reminde."

Additionally, the correct spelling of "**once**" has been used in this sentence. Therefore, option 4 is the correct answer.
